description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_Response_Stream, a subclass of Zend_Http_Response, which provides functionality to handle HTTP responses with stream contents. It includes methods for managing stream resources, setting and retrieving stream information, and constructing response objects from stream data.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Response_Stream
classes.description: A subclass of Zend_Http_Response that adds support for handling responses with stream bodies, including stream management and cleanup.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the stream resource associated with the response.

methods.name: setStream
methods.description: Sets the stream resource for the response.

methods.name: getCleanup
methods.description: Returns whether the cleanup will be performed when the response is destroyed.

methods.name: setCleanup
methods.description: Sets whether the stream file should be cleaned up when the response is destroyed.

methods.name: getStreamName
methods.description: Returns the file name associated with the stream, if applicable.

methods.name: setStreamName
methods.description: Sets the file name associated with the stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the response object, optionally with a stream resource.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Creates a new instance from a response string and a stream resource.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the response body as a string, reading from the stream if necessary.

methods.name: getRawBody
methods.description: Returns the raw response body as transferred over the wire, without decoding.

methods.name: readStream
methods.description: Reads the content of the stream and stores it in the response body.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up the stream and deletes associated file if cleanup is enabled.
